notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou each turn.
description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Skullwinder.
When the Skullwinder token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
